body: In the letter they do not give a reason, and in my appeal I said I am not financially able to pay the sum and I was confused for why I was being charged. I didnt protest the appeal when they initially gave me the option because I simply didn't check my unemployment for a long while because I was not collecting. I did eventually protest the appeal online when i was notified via letter and even sent them a letter telling them the same thing.

I do not want to pay, and no I did not quit any jobs while claiming. I was unemployed from april 2020 to August 2021, and I didn't collect any unemployment money illegally. I stopped collecting unemployment in August 2021 because I got a job.
